title: Extract provider generated media artifact writer boundary
description: TTS providers repeat output_dir defaults, next_audio_path, display_path, directory creation, and audio file writes. Extract a shared generated-media artifact boundary before adding more voice providers or persistent attachment storage.

files.change: Own provider output directory, file naming, extension handling, display path conversion, and write errors.
Delegate output path and audio writing to the shared artifact writer.

criteria: Concrete TTS providers no longer duplicate create_dir_all/fs::write/display_path helpers.
Provider-specific audio decoding and protocol parsing stay inside adapters.
Existing audio output tests still prove extension and bytes.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo clippy -p astrbot-provider -- -D warnings
